directives.directive: count_nonconforming_rows() is a whole-table aggregate, so it also counts other stories' nonconforming rows sharing stock_records. In the autouse _clean_integrity_probe_rows fixture, after deleting this test's own _TEST_SKUS rows (and before any Given step inserts them), capture a baseline via StockService(StockRepository(db_session)).count_nonconforming_rows() and yield it as a fixture (e.g. baseline_nonconforming_count). Change the_probe_reports_a_nonconforming_count to request that fixture and assert (nonconforming_count - baseline_nonconforming_count) == count instead of nonconforming_count == count, so the invariant is scoped as a delta produced only by this scenario's own seeded rows, never an absolute whole-table total.

Same fix as the sibling scenarios in this file: count_nonconforming_rows() aggregates the entire stock_records table, so it picks up nonconforming rows left by other stories. Capture a pre-seed baseline count (post-cleanup, pre-Given) in the autouse _clean_integrity_probe_rows fixture and expose it as a fixture value; have the_probe_reports_a_nonconforming_count assert (nonconforming_count - baseline_nonconforming_count) == count rather than an absolute nonconforming_count == count, keeping the same nonconforming-count invariant but scoped to only the rows this scenario itself inserted (its own SKUs in _TEST_SKUS).
